releaseNotes: Improve Android widget item spacing and move important stars to the right edge.
Open widget quick-add and item-edit actions in a lightweight popup activity.
Add a temporary widget updating overlay for mark-as-done actions.
Debounce automatic background sync after local edits and widget actions.
Add pull-to-sync in task lists and a top-bar sync action.
Move sign out into a separate confirmed section in the App tab.
